# Gallart.com - Fine Art Gallery

> Gallart (Gallery Art) is a premier fine art gallery founded in 1989 in South Florida, offering over 40 years of expertise in buying, selling, appraising, framing, and authenticating modern, contemporary, and pop fine art. Operating an 8,000+ square foot showroom in Aventura, Florida, Gallart serves collectors, interior designers, investors, and museums worldwide.

## Key Information
- **Website**: https://gallart.com
- **Physical Gallery**: 20633 Biscayne Blvd Suite C2, Aventura, FL 33180, United States
- **Phone**: +1-305-932-6166
- **Established**: 1989
- **Specialties**: Modern Art, Contemporary Art, Pop Art, Blue-Chip Art, Sculpture, Limited Edition Prints, Original Oils and Acrylics
- **Services**: Fine Art Buying & Consignment, Private Sales, Custom Museum-Quality Framing, Worldwide Insured Shipping, Art Appraisals & Certificates of Authenticity (COA)

## Renowned Artists Represented
Gallart features original works and authenticated editions by leading modern and contemporary masters:
- **Andy Warhol** (Silkscreens, Prints, Paintings, Campbell's Soup, Marilyn, Flowers)
- **Keith Haring** (Pop Shop, Silkscreens, Lithographs, Drawings)
- **Roy Lichtenstein** (Pop Art, Lithographs, Screenprints, Sculptures)
- **Peter Max** (Cosmic Series, Liberty, Pop Originals)
- **Tom Wesselmann** (Great American Nudes, Still Lifes, Metal Cuts)
- **Pablo Picasso** (Ceramics, Lithographs, Etchings, Linocuts)
- **Marc Chagall** (Biblical Lithographs, Original Works)
- **Romero Britto** (Pop Art Sculptures, Paintings, Prints)
- **Mr. Brainwash** (Street Art, Stencils, Mixed Media)
- **Leroy Neiman** (Sports & Cultural Serigraphs)
- **Salvador Dali**, **Joan Miro**, **Robert Indiana**, **Takashi Murakami**, **Kaws**, and more.
